    (x -> upper(x)) AS trim
SELECT arrayMap(trim | upper, ['x'])

FROM
(
    SELECT 1 AS trim
) AS t

WITH
    arrayMap(trim | upper, ['x']) AS unused
SELECT 1

SELECT arrayMap(x -> lower(t.n), t.a)
FROM
(
    SELECT
        accurateCastOrNull('bad', 'UInt8') AS n,
        CAST(['x'], 'Array(String)') AS a
) AS t

SELECT
    CAST([1], 'Array(UInt8)') AS a,
    arrayMap(lower | upper, a)
FROM
(
    SELECT CAST(['x'], 'Array(String)') AS a
) AS t
SETTINGS prefer_column_name_to_alias = 1

WITH
    ((f, a) -> ['ok']) AS arrayMap
SELECT arrayMap(trim | upper, ['x'])
